paite: Huaiziak in bil a i zakte phatuamngaitak in i khawk sa nawn sem ding uh, huchi lou in zaw i tolhmangsan kha zenzen ding uhi.
heading: Hotdamna Thupi
english: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.

paite: Angelte zang a thugen nangawn akip a, tatlekna leh thumanlouhna chiteng in thukna diktathuaitak amuh zel ngal un,
english: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompense;

paite: huchi tel a hotdamna thupi ngeingaih kei leng bangchi in ahia i suahtak theih mahmah ding? Huai hotdamna thu atung a Toupa zang a gen khit ahi a, azate'n hon na hihkipsak uhi.
english: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard;

paite: Pathian in leng chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte leh thilhihtheihna chiteng toh, ama deih bang zel in Kha Siangthou thilhawmte toh, amaute atheihpih hi.
english: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?

paite: Khovel hong om ding a tanchin i gen uh, angelte nuai ah akoih kei hi.
heading: Hotdamna Makaipa
english: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.

paite: Himahleh mi kuahiam in koi lai hiam ah hiai thu gen in atheisak hi, "Mihing bang atel a, na theihgige? Mihing tapa leng bang ahia, na veh nak?”
english: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?

paite: "Amah angelte sang a nuaizaw zek in na bawl a; thupina leh pahtawina na khusak a, na khutsuak tung ah heutu in na bawl hi,
english: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor. TR adds “and set him over the works of your hands”

paite: akhenuai ah bangkim na koih a," chi in. Huchi in bangkim anuai a akoih ziak in anuai a koih louh bangmah anei kei hi. Himahleh tu'n ah zaw bangkim anuai a om in i mu nai tadih kei uhi.
english: You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” Psalm 8:4-6 For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don’t see all things subjected to him, yet.

paite: Himahleh Jesu, angelte sang a niamzaw deuh a abawl takdih tuh, sihna thuak in thupina leh pahtawina khuksak a om in i mu zaw, huchi a Pathian hehpihna ziak a michih a ding a sihna acheptheihna ding in.
english: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.

paite: Amah a ding leh amah ziak a bangkim omsakpa'n tapa tampi thupina a pilut a, athuakna ziak a amaute hotdamna makaipa bukim hih amah a dia kilawm him ahi.
english: For it became him, for whom are all things, and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

paite: Hihsiangthoupa leh hihsiang-thoute avek un mi khat a pawt ahi uh. Huaiziak in ama'n amaute unaute, chih azum kei hi.
english: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” ,

paite: "Ka unaute kiang ah na min ka gen dia; omkhawmte lak ah la sa in ka hon phat ding,” chi in.
english: saying, “I will declare your name to my brothers. In the midst of the congregation I will sing your praise.” Psalm 22:22

paite: Huan "Amah ah ka muanna ka nga dia, achi nawn hi. Huan en dih ua, kei leh Pathian hon piak tate," achi nawn lai hi.
english: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Isaiah 8:17 Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.” Isaiah 8:18

paite: Huchi in naupangte sa leh sisan tangte ahih chiat ziak un, amah ngei in huai bangmah atang sam hi; asihna a sihna thuneipa, diabol, ahihmanthat theihna ding leh,
english: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,

paite: sih kihtak ziak a damsung sikha a omte tengteng asuahtaksak theihna ding un.
english: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

paite: Ahitak in, ama'n apanpih zelte zaw angelte ahi kei ua, Abraham suante apanpih zaw ahi.
english: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the seed of Abraham.

paite: Huchi in mite a ding a khelhna thupha tawina bawlsak ding in, Pathian lam a siampu lianpen, milainat thei leh muanhuaitak ahihtheihna ding in, bangkim a-unaute bang a hong om amah a ding in akiphamoh him ahi.
english: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.

paite: Amah ngei in khemna tuak a, ana thuak tak ziak in khemna tuakte apanpih thei ahi.
english: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.
